info.title: Scrinly Browser API
info.description: Public screenshot, region, Visual Style Guide, visual diff, monitoring, batch, job-status, and usage API.

get.description: Returns JPEG or PNG bytes unless storage, regions, asynchronous delivery, or Visual Style Guide requires a JSON result.

post.description: Accepts up to 100 URLs. Public batches are screenshot-only and reserve one credit per accepted item.

patch.summary: Update, pause, or resume a monitor

post.summary: Replace a fixed or rolling baseline

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Single-use token from the verification email.

Device.name: device
Device.description: Server-supported device preset; overrides width and height.

Regions.name: regions
Regions.description: Adds ordered full-page crops and two credits; implies full-page storage.

StyleGuide.name: styleGuide
StyleGuide.description: Adds a GPT-5.6 Luna Visual Style Guide; implies regions and stored full-page capture.

Regenerate.name: regenerate
Regenerate.description: Bypasses only the seven-day Style Guide cache. Requires styleGuide=true.

ProviderApiKey.name: X-Scrinly-Provider-API-Key
ProviderApiKey.description: Ephemeral OpenAI BYOK for Visual Style Guide. Server-to-server and synchronous only.

StorageUrl.description: Direct URL for the complete stored output.

CreditsUsed.description: Credits used in the current allowance after settlement.

ScreenshotSuccess.description: Binary or JSON screenshot result. JSON may be partial when an add-on failed.

PlanRestricted.description: Plan does not allow the requested monitor capacity or cadence

CaptureFailed.description: Complete finite screenshot could not be produced

DiffFailed.description: Source integrity or diff processing failed; credit refunded

Unavailable.description: Required platform configuration or provider unavailable

device.description: Server-supported preset; overrides width and height.

regenerate.description: Requires Style Guide; bypasses only its AI cache.

url.description: Direct B2, S3, or R2 URL.

emailMasked.description: Safe masked address; plaintext addresses are encrypted at rest.
